text: ສະບາຍດີ ທ່ານຜູ້ຊົມທຸກທ່ານ ຍິນດີຕ້ອນຮັບເຂົ້າສູ່ລາຍການເຕະບານຂອງພວກເຮົາ ມື້ນີ້ເຮົາຈະມາເວົ້າເລື່ອງ Premier  League  ແລະ Champions  League
desc: A man in his early thirties with a clear, bright, clean mid-pitched voice. Very crisp and precise articulation, every syllable distinct. Energetic, friendly football analyst talking to fans, fluent in English
